description: Per user 2026-07-15: materializers hold significant disk/memory; after a configurable period with NO client reads they should shut down gracefully. One mechanism, three wins: reaps recruitment orphans without a GC (no reads -> dies; subsumes most of bedrock-q67.11), implements the epic's deferred 'zero materializers for cold shards', reclaims resources. Design: track last-read activity in the materializer server (reads only, not transaction application); configurable idle_timeout (startup opt/cluster config; propose a sane default and flag it in the PR); on expiry exit with reason {:shutdown, :idle} after best-effort snapshot upload; SYSTEM SHARD EXEMPT. Distributor healing must distinguish {:shutdown, :idle} from crashes: idle death -> placeholder swap only, NO eager re-recruitment (demand-driven revival), else the system fights its own spin-down. Foreman worker-entry cleanup on idle exit.
title: Materializer idle spin-down: configurable inactivity timeout reclaims disk/memory
